title: Typo in the HTTP header documentation
body:
### Version

5.0.0

### Context

Hi, sorry for writing here, I a bit confused what is current web site repo.

Here https://vertx.io/docs/vertx-core/java/#_request_authority as for now there is a typo, it is written

```
Use [authority](https://vertx.io/docs/apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/HttpServerRequest.html#authority--) to return the authority of the HTTP request.

For HTTP/1.x requests the host header is returned, for HTTP/1 requests the :authority pseudo header is returned.
``` 
but actually second sentence should contain HTTP/2
